product.summary: Rabby mobile wallet application for iOS and Android.
product.notes: Rabby's official mobile repository begins development in late 2023, then records version 0.1.0 being prepared for publishing on 2024-01-29 and an explicit publish of 0.1.1 on 2024-03-01. WLR records 2024 at year precision because the reviewed source history establishes the public release lineage during 2024 but does not establish one defensible exact first App Store or Play Store release day.

events.title: Rabby Mobile released in 2024
events.description: Rabby's official mobile repository establishes the transition from late-2023 development into a public mobile release lineage during 2024, including 0.1.0 publish preparation and an explicit 0.1.1 publish commit.
events.notes: Year precision only. The initial repository commit in 2023 is development evidence, not launch evidence; the 2024 publish-history does not establish one exact first public store-release day.

evidence.title: Rabby Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution page lists Extension, Mobile, and Desktop products.

evidence.title: RabbyHub official repositories
evidence.notes: Official organization listing identifies rabby-mobile and RabbyDesktop as separate applications.

evidence.title: Rabby Mobile 0.1.0 publish preparation
evidence.notes: Official Rabby Mobile repository commit that sets version 0.1.0 for publish and includes iOS App Store publishing configuration and Android build/deploy work. Used to establish the 2024 release lineage, not as an exact public launch-day assertion.

evidence.title: Rabby Mobile publish 0.1.1
evidence.notes: Official Rabby Mobile repository commit explicitly publishing version 0.1.1. Used as first-party corroboration that the public release lineage was active during 2024, not as proof that 2024-03-01 was the first launch day.
